benchmark: BIRD Mini-Dev (SQLite), fixed stratified 150-question subset (seed 13; train/val/test 50 each)
metric: EX — execution accuracy, BIRD official set comparison of predicted vs gold result rows
cost_note: list_price_cost_usd = tokens × published paid list price; actual spend is $0 (free tiers)
inclusion_rule: latest real (non-fake) run per config on subset_150 with n ≥ 20; test split preferred

C0.label: baseline
C0.description: One LLM call: full schema with column descriptions + BIRD evidence, one direct candidate. No linking, voting, repair, verifier or cache.

failed_cases.question: What is the complete address of the school with the lowest excellence rate? Indicate the Street, City, Zip and State.
failed_cases.evidence: Execellence Rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; complete address has Street, City, State, Zip code
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC LIMIT 1
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

failed_cases.question: List all the mythic rarity print cards banned in gladiator format.
failed_cases.evidence: mythic rarity printing refers to rarity = 'mythic'; card banned refers to status = 'Banned'; in gladiator format refers to format = 'gladiator';
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.format = 'gladiator' AND T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.rarity = 'mythic'
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'

failed_cases.question: At present, calculate for the player's age who have a sprint speed of no less than 97 between 2013 to 2015.
failed_cases.evidence: players age at present = SUBTRACT((DATETIME(), birthday)); sprint speed of no less than 97 refers to sprint_speed > = 97; between 2013 to 2015 refers to YEAR(date) > = '2013' AND YEAR(date) < = '2015';
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT DATETIME() - T2.birthday age FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) >= '2013' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t1.`date`) <= '2015' AND t1.sprint_speed >= 97
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'

failed_cases.question: For loans contracts which are still running where client are in debt, list the district of the and the state the percentage unemployment rate increment from year 1995 to 1996.
failed_cases.evidence: Unemployment increment rate in percentage = [(unemployment rate 2016 - unemployment rate 2015) / unemployment rate 2015] * 100; unemployment rate 2015 appears in the A12; unemployment rate 2016 appears in the A13; Loan contracts which are still running where client are in debt can be presented as status = 'D'
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT CAST((T3.A13 - T3.A12) AS REAL) * 100 / T3.A12 FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.status = 'D'
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    CAST((d.A13 - d.A12) AS REAL) / d.A12 * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

failed_cases.question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
failed_cases.evidence: race number refers to raceId; second qualifying period refers to q2; best lap time refers to MIN(q2);
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1

failed_cases.question: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?
failed_cases.evidence: meetings events refers to type = 'Meeting'; attended by more than 10 members refers to COUNT(event_id) > 10
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1  INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event GROUP BY T1.event_id  HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10 EXCEPT SELECT T1.event_name  FROM event AS T1  WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting'
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
GROUP BY e.event_id
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10

failed_cases.question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
failed_cases.evidence: single-bonded molecules refers to bond_type = '-' ; average number of oxygen atom = AVG(element = 'o')
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

failed_cases.question: Please list the product description of the products consumed in September, 2013.
failed_cases.evidence: September 2013 refers to 201309; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT T3.Description FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID WHERE T2.Date = '201309'
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-09'

failed_cases.question: What is the average number of crimes committed in 1995 in regions where the number exceeds 4000 and the region has accounts that are opened starting from the year 1997?
failed_cases.evidence: A3 refers to region names; A15 stands for the average number of crimes commited in 1995.
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T1.A15) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.date) >= '1997' AND T1.A15 > 4000
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT AVG(d.A15) AS average_crimes_1995
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
      AND substr(a.date, 1, 2) >= '97'
  )

failed_cases.question: List the names of all races that occurred in the earliest recorded year and month.
failed_cases.evidence: earliest recorded year and month refers to year = year(min(date)) and month = month(min(date));
failed_cases.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM races WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = ( SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', date) FROM races ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1 ) AND STRFTIME('%m', date) = ( SELECT STRFTIME('%m', date) FROM races ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1 )
failed_cases.pred_sql:
SELECT r.name
FROM races r
WHERE r.date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM races)
